name: LlamaIndex + PostgreSQL pgvector
note: Every task runs a real command. The starter's default vector layer is its in-memory mode with a deterministic hash embedder; PostgreSQL is replaced by a recording psycopg stub wherever SQL is involved, so no database or model is needed. The starter has no SQL read/write path (ingest and query always use the in-memory store), so only the DDL, identifier validation and credential handling are verified, not parameterised queries. The faithfulness scorer is a lexical-overlap heuristic, not LlamaIndex's LLM-based evaluator. Token figures are not recorded here; evals/runner.py measures context cost from the kit files.

eval_tasks.title: Ingest and tenant-isolated retrieval
eval_tasks.instruction: A document must be chunked and indexed, and every query must be pinned to one tenant that a caller-supplied filter cannot override.
assertions: a document is indexed with HTTP 201 and retrieved with its delimited citation block
tenant A never sees tenant B nodes over HTTP and vice versa
queries and ingests without a tenant are rejected with 422 and at service level
a spoofed tenant_id in the filter is overridden by the trusted tenant
extra filters cannot widen the tenant scope
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python -m pytest tests -k "ingest or tenant or semantic_search or pins_trusted" -q -p no:warnings

eval_tasks.title: pgvector schema, HNSW index and credential handling
eval_tasks.instruction: The schema must create an HNSW cosine index and a metadata GIN index, the table name must be a validated identifier, and no database credential may be hardcoded or defaulted.
assertions: the DDL contains the vector extension, vector(384), an HNSW vector_cosine_ops index with m=16 and ef_construction=100, and a GIN metadata index
initialize executes every DDL statement then commits, and falls back to memory when the database is unreachable
table names with injection characters are rejected
the connection password comes only from the environment with no default
no python source hardcodes a password
compose carries no literal password and does not publish the database port
credential-named keys in .env.example are empty
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python -m pytest tests -k "table_name or schema or initialize or password or hardcoded or compose or env_example" -q -p no:warnings

eval_tasks.title: Faithfulness guardrail and prompt-injection boundary
eval_tasks.instruction: Hallucinated or partially grounded answers must fail the faithfulness check, and retrieved nodes must be delimited untrusted data they cannot escape.
assertions: the faithfulness threshold is 0.8
a hallucinated, partially grounded or context-free answer fails faithfulness
a grounded answer passes
an off-topic answer fails relevancy
each node sits in a delimited block it cannot close and document ids cannot inject markup
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python -m pytest tests -k "faithfulness or hallucinat or grounded or relevancy or evaluate or context or delimiter or markup or rag_evaluation" -q -p no:warnings

eval_tasks.title: Health, errors, CORS, limits and container hardening
eval_tasks.instruction: Health must reflect database reachability, errors must not leak internals, a wildcard origin must never be honoured, inputs must be bounded, and the image must run non-root.
assertions: health is degraded when the database is down and ok when it answers
an unhandled error returns a generic 500 with no host, secret or traceback
a wildcard origin is dropped and unlisted origins get no allow header
oversized or malformed bodies are rejected with 422
a non-advancing chunk window is rejected instead of looping forever
the default score threshold is 0.60
the final Dockerfile stage drops to a numeric UID >= 10000
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python -m pytest tests -k "health or unhandled or cors or oversized or chunker or default_score or non_root" -q -p no:warnings

eval_tasks.title: Full suite green
eval_tasks.instruction: The complete functional and security suite must pass with no failures.
assertions: pytest exits 0 across tests/
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python -m pytest tests/ -q -p no:warnings
